input: Requests through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc-db-broker), which hands this table module its connection: a short or the B-roll shot of a cover (clip id, clip name, player-confirmed IN/OUT frames), stills of a short, lists.
output: The virtual_shots table of the project database and its public views public_short_clips and public_b_roll_clips: shorts with IN/OUT still status and URIs, and the B-roll shots of covers (v5 add_virtual_shot_from_frames, made before the cover). It creates only its own table, writes no other (authorizer), reads public_project_settings and the clip catalog through qnc-content-read (only an imported clip). Moved unchanged from qnc-content-store (lego split B4, user rule 2026-09-26).
